newsitem.title: FRANCE: Negotiations to resume at TAT-Air Liberte-Le Monde.
newsitem.headline: Negotiations to resume at TAT-Air Liberte-Le Monde.

text.p: Talks between unions, who have now been on strike for 13 days, and management at British Airways' French airlines Air Liberte and TAT will resume today at 1200 GMT, French daily Le Monde reported on Monday.

Air Liberte managing director Marc Rochet accepted a meeting with unions late Friday night after strikers broke into its headquarters, and he proposed a preliminary agreement which unions are still discussing with their rank and file members.
Strikers at TAT oppose the terms of the leasing of TAT by Air Liberte, effective since April 1, ahead of an eventual merger by the end of this year.
They fear their status will be brought in line with that of Air Liberte staff, who are not as well paid, the paper reported.
